what: Controlled load against the public pilot's production API: closed-loop stages at 1, 10, 25 and 50 requests in flight, open-loop stages at 3 and 5 requests a second, a mixed-length journey stage and a place-search stage, with every answer checked, host and container resources sampled each second, public latency and readiness probed from outside, and telemetry flowing to Grafana Cloud throughout.
not_a_claim_about: real users, visitors or business scale. A virtual user here is a closed loop with no think time: N virtual users means N requests in flight at every moment.

serving.changed_by_this_run: nothing: no deploy, restart or configuration change; the API fix in this PR is not deployed

host.provider: OVH VPS, Ubuntu 26.04, 2 vCPU, 3,814 MiB RAM, 2 GiB swap, 38 GB disk
host.api: one uvicorn process, routes computed on its event loop; cgroup limit 1,536 MiB
host.uptime_note: host rebooted by unattended-upgrades 2026-11-14T08:30Z; every container started then and has restart count 0

dataset.content_checksum: 4a179dc08319a1d8524dfb949a3cec42b02988b40a71e4fbc869870bc5238f00, recorded on the host at the 905364e deploy; not recomputed in this run
dataset.attribution: Routes derive from OpenStreetMap data, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0

methodology.target: the production API process at http://api:8000 on the pilot's Compose edge network, from a k6 container on the same host; the public path (internet, Caddy, TLS) measured alongside from a laptop in Ontario
methodology.why_inside_the_host: the API limits each client to 30 routes and 60 searches a minute and Caddy discards any X-Forwarded-For a client sends, so load from one machine through the public URL measures only the limiter; the limiter itself is measured through the public path (public_rate_limit)
methodology.synthetic_clients: each request's X-Forwarded-For is the next of 762 addresses in the RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24): the limiter sees many clients, none near its limit, and none can be a real visitor. No host stage received a 429.

workloads.route: POST /api/v1/routes/compare, the smoke journey (Davis Centre Library to Student Life Centre, wheelchair profile), coordinates from production place search in this run
workloads.mix: the smoke journey and three 1.3-1.6 km corpus journeys in turn, each checked against the answer production gave sequentially in this run
workloads.search: POST /api/v1/geocode/search, a submitted search for each journey end (checked) alternating with as-you-type prefixes

methodology.stage_order_and_rests: c01, c10, c25, c50, mix10, r3, r5, s10, each followed by at least 60 s idle; each later stage ran only after the previous one's gates were read (errors, mismatches, API memory, host memory, readiness, restarts, Alloy)
methodology.abort_limits: API anonymous memory above 1,300 MiB, host MemAvailable below 400 MiB, or public readiness failing without a break for 60 s (45 s for c50); none triggered
methodology.public_watch: laptop: readiness every 5 s and the smoke journey every 4 s (0.25/s, half one client's refill), 23:27 to 23:46 UTC
methodology.external_monitors: Alloy's blackbox probe and Grafana Synthetic Monitoring's two locations, read from Caddy's access log by user agent; client addresses dropped
methodology.server_side_quantiles: differenced API histograms read like histogram_quantile: linear within buckets, so coarse above 2.5 s (buckets 2.5, 5, 10 s) and capped at 10 s; they include the public watch's requests
methodology.clocks: host and laptop timestamps are UTC from NTP-synchronised clocks, aligned by epoch
